```python
from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=7.06, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 9.05 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.91, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 6.38 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=13.12, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 4.16 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.87, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 1.88 * vars['Var_3']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MAXIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(2.23 * vars['Var_1'] <= 17.51, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(9.98 * vars['Var_1'] <= 70.91, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(-0.7 * vars['Var_1'] <= -3.78, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(7.53 * vars['Var_2'] <= 42.66, name='C3')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
```

Subject: Mix plan to maximize contribution under staffing, logistics, sustainability, and equipment limits

Team,

As discussed, we want to maximize total contribution this cycle by choosing the right mix of four initiatives. Most of these decisions need to be made in whole units; one of them can be set to fractional volumes. Below is the business framing of each lever and how it draws on our limited capacities and compliance targets.

- Signature Club Membership Drives
  • Financials: Each full drive contributes 9.05 to contribution.
  • Volume: We can run anywhere from zero drives up to a ceiling of 7.06 drives; these are whole-drive decisions only.
  • Resource/limit impact: This activity does not require any skilled technician shifts, does not take any loading dock windows, does not move our net emissions index, and does not consume any Column Bravo operating hours.

- Eco‑Route Conversions (green distribution upgrades)
  • Financials: Each conversion adds 6.38 to contribution.
  • Volume: We may complete between zero and 10.91 conversions, in whole conversions only.
  • Resource/limit impact: Every conversion uses 2.23 skilled technician shifts and 9.98 loading dock windows. Importantly, each conversion improves our sustainability position by 0.70 units (it counts as a reduction against the baseline). These upgrades do not require any Column Bravo operating hours.

- Column Bravo Contract Production (custom distillation volume)
  • Financials: Each unit of volume scheduled on Column Bravo contributes 4.16 to contribution.
  • Volume: We can dial this anywhere from zero up to 13.12 units, including partial units (fractional volumes are acceptable).
  • Resource/limit impact: Each unit of this work uses 7.53 operating hours on Column Bravo. It does not require any skilled technician shifts, does not take any loading dock windows, and has no effect on our net emissions index.

- Digital Gift Card Activations
  • Financials: Each activation block contributes 1.88 to contribution.
  • Volume: We can activate anywhere from zero up to 11.87 blocks, in whole blocks only.
  • Resource/limit impact: These activations do not use any skilled technician shifts, do not take any loading dock windows, do not change our net emissions index, and do not require Column Bravo operating hours.

Facility specs and policy limits for this planning window
- Skilled Technician Shifts: We can allocate no more than 17.51 shifts in total.
- Loading Dock Windows: We can assign no more than 70.91 windows in total.
- Net Emissions Index vs Baseline: Our combined plan must land at or below −3.78 (negative values reflect reductions relative to the baseline; the Eco‑Route conversions are the only lever that moves this metric, improving it by 0.70 per conversion).
- Column Bravo Operating Hours: We can schedule no more than 42.66 hours in total.

Our goal is to maximize contribution while respecting all of the above limits and ceilings. Please use this framing to structure the optimization and bring back the recommended mix.

Best regards,

Maya Chen
VP, Operations
